players.adp_commentary: RB1 off the board at ~1.5. In a 2-RB/2-FLEX half-PPR league the elite bell-cow RB is the scarcest resource (top VORP tier), and Bijan's clean availability + workhorse role justify 1.01 cost despite Atlanta's stated wide-zone usage-cap talk.

Two mild watches, neither structural: Stefanski is ramping him back deliberately after the hold-in ('slowly get him back in there. He won't be full go'), and Brian Robinson Jr. is a genuine complement the staff has lined up alongside him rather than a pure backup.
scouting_brief.rationale: Hold-in resolved by a record-setting extension; Stefanski features him in the Peterson/Chubb tier with Allgeier's goal-line work vacated. A deliberate camp ramp-up and a capable Brian Robinson Jr. are the only watches.
